Bihar BJP MLA gets 4-year jail for celebratory firing death

A Bihar BJP MLA has been sentenced to four years in prison by a court for a celebratory firing incident that resulted in the death of a woman doctor. The conviction also carries a potential disqualification from the state assembly. The court ordered the MLA to pay compensation to the victim's family.
